slides.headline:
Going to your
first 5s
*alone*?
slides.sub: 5 things that make it easy. Save this for later.

slides.title: Message the *organiser*
slides.body: “First time, happy to fill in anywhere.” Organisers love that player.

slides.title: Arrive *10 min early*
slides.body: Say your name twice. By kick-off you'll know three people.

slides.title: Bring a *light and a dark* shirt
slides.body: No bibs? You're sorted. Instant friend.

slides.title: Pass early, *talk loud*
slides.body: Nobody remembers your touch. They remember you called for it.

slides.title: Stay for the *after-chat*
slides.body: That's where the crew forms. Same time next week?

slides.headline:
Come alone.
Leave with
a *crew*.
slides.body: Free 5-a-side games in Cape Town, area by area.
